store.21: I've been involved in undergraduate research since the end of my sophomore year, and it's been a truly eye-opening experience. It's given me a glimpse into how knowledge is created in the tech world, and I'm proud to be a part of it. As a freshman, I didn't initially see myself going down the research route. I was more interested in coding projects and hackathons. However, one of my professors, who taught an introductory data science class, noticed my ability to bridge technical coding with user experience. She encouraged me to apply for a research assistant position in a lab focused on data visualization for big scientific datasets. I was initially hesitant due to the intimidation factor, but I decided to take the leap. It turned out to be a great decision.
